This bill directs the Director of National Intelligence (DNI) to submit to Congress a report on foreign fighter flows to and from terrorist safe havens abroad. The report shall include: (1) the total number of foreign fighters who have traveled to and from terrorist safe havens since 2011, including those who have returned to their countries of origin; (2) the total number of U.S. citizens who have traveled or attempted to travel to such safe havens; (3) the total number of foreign fighters in terrorist safe havens as of the date of the report; (4) the total number of foreign fighters who have left such safe havens or whose whereabouts are unknown; and (5) a worldwide assessment of foreign country efforts to track and control the flow of foreign fighters to and from such safe havens. The DNI shall submit such report in unclassified form, but may include a classified annex.
